item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find strong 2023 evidence that Putin habitually told the truth to the legislature, courts, or allies in a way that was independently documented and directly comparable across settings. The public record I could verify is dominated by speeches, press statements, and Reuters coverage, so the clearest evidence comes from public-facing falsehoods and a small number of crisis statements that look partially candid.","evidence":[{"title":"Russia's Putin says he let mutiny continue to avoid bloodshed","publisher":"Reuters","date":"26 Jun 2023","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/russias-putin-says-he-let-mutiny-continue-to-avoid-bloodshed-3113594","summary":"Putin said he had directed steps to avoid serious bloodshed during the Wagner crisis. This is the strongest 2023 example of candid self-reporting I found, but it is narrow crisis management, not evidence of a general truth-telling habit.","question_ids":["7B.1"]},{"title":"Putin says
